newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast bourse rises on week in low volume.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast bourse rises on week in low volume.

text.p: The Ivory Coast Stock Exchange continued its upward trend this week with a slight rise, but trading volume was low, the market report showed on Friday.
The All-Share index, the 'BVA', rose 0.91 percent to 486.72, up from 482.32 points the previous week. The blue-chip index, the '12VB', rose by 0.21 percent and closed at 329.57 from 328.87 points.
Since the start of the year the BVA has risen by 36.03 percent and the 12VB by 36.19 percent.
Some 7,979 shares worth 249 million CFA francs were traded compared to 33,762 shares worth 919 million the previous week.
Tarmac manufacturer SMB, closed 2,050 CFA francs higher at 22,050. Rubber manufacturer SOGB rose 1,450 CFA francs to 15,650.
